I've tested my hypothesis: any non-zero, non-line pixels below the horizontal line become color 7, and it holds! Ex 1 shows that all 6s become 7s, Ex 2 that all 4s become 7s, and Ex 3 that all 5s become 7s. This seems like a consistent rule.
